author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Given that Adam Savage's dad didn't enjoy Star Wars, what did he think of Adam's work on it? When defeated by a project, what does Adam do for comfort? In this live stream excerpt, Adam answers these questions from Tested members Silver Defender and Gwen-Maker-of-Things, whom we thank for their support!
